strategies.name: fair_value_gap_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the prevailing trend after a fair value gap that caused a break of structure forms. Mark the three-candle fair value gap, preferably one close to an order block, and enter when price retraces back into that gap.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap itself—below the FVG for buys and above the FVG for sells—and hold for continuation in the trend direction; no concrete profit-target rule is given beyond waiting for price to continue.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to tap back into the bullish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: price will most likely come back mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to return to the bearish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

result.enumeration_note: One runnable strategy is taught: FVG trend-continuation retest, shown in bullish and bearish directions as compatible variants. The speaker gives a usable stop-loss rule, but no fixed target/profit-taking mechanic beyond continuation.
